introHtml: Terrytown cooling sport towels combine moisture-wicking performance with the plush feel of terry cloth, making them ideal for athletes and outdoor workers. Unlike standard polyester cooling towels, these offer a soft, absorbent texture that feels comfortable against the skin while still providing evaporative cooling. Bulk orders allow you to add your logo via screen printing or heat transfer, creating a practical giveaway for golf tournaments, corporate wellness programs, or safety kits.
